threads.body: The docs no longer mention that GenAI event emission and the span_only/event_only/span_and_event content-capture modes are gated by semantic-convention stability opt-in. Without `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental`, the util layer will not emit the `gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details` log event and will not record message content attributes/events, even if `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT` is set to one of these modes. This is also inconsistent with this package’s example READMEs, which still document the stability flag.

threads.body: This embeddings wrapper path still creates spans directly via a `Tracer` rather than going through `opentelemetry-util-genai`’s `TelemetryHandler`, which violates the repo’s instrumentation guidance (see `.github/instructions/instrumentation.instructions.md#2-telemetry-and-configuration-via-opentelemetry-util-genai`). Now that the instrumentation is switching to latest-only semconv routing, it would be a good time to migrate embeddings to the util’s embedding invocation lifecycle as well, so spans/metrics/events/config are consistently handled in one place.
